subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], Thank you for booking your flight with us. We are pleased to confirm your reservation for the following itinerary: Flight Number: ABC123 Departure: June 15, 2023 at 10:00 AM Destination: New York City If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, please contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airline Team
